text: Officials say: have supplies for at least seventy-two hours.
After a big disaster, rescuers can't reach everyone at once.
They handle the worst emergencies first.
So each home must manage alone for three days.
Three days is also roughly how long you last without water. Less in the heat.
So water comes first: one gallon per person, per day.
And that's only the minimum. Switzerland and Sweden suggest a week.
Could you last seventy-two hours? Comment yes or no.
